headline: Hyperscalers charge double or more over neoclouds on every GPU; MI300X leads price-performance at $1.83 per PFLOP-hour.
bullets: H100 SXM shows the widest hyperscaler premium at +217%, with a hyperscaler median of $12.12 versus $3.82 at neoclouds, while Vast.ai is cheapest at $2.54.
MI300X offers the best price-performance at $1.83 per PFLOP-hour, and its marketplace median of $0.50 sits far below its $2.39 market index, though only 3 providers list it.
B200 has a market index of $6.84 and costs $3.04 per PFLOP-hour, cheaper per unit of compute than H200 at $4.68 despite H200's lower $4.63 index.
A100 80GB SXM is the least efficient at $7.02 per PFLOP-hour even with a low $2.19 market index and the smallest hyperscaler premium at +100%.
RunPod Community Cloud is the cheapest provider for B200 at $5.98, H200 at $3.59, MI300X at $0.50, and L40S at $0.79.
watch: With only 1 day of history, watch whether the +217% H100 SXM and +214% MI300X hyperscaler premiums hold as the 7-day trend window fills.
